name: [UPDATE🏡] Baton Rouge : Tha Trenches
desc:
Welcome to Baton Rouge Hood – The MOST Dangerous Game on Roblox!

Step into the streets of Baton Rouge, the USA murder capital! Will you survive the chaos or become just another statistic? Your fate is in your hands.

– Fight crime or become part of it 🚔
– Spin blocks and take over control 👑
– Join gangs for weapons, cash, and resources 🔫
– Buy your own apartment 🏠
– Show off with exotic cars 🏎️

You get REWARDS for joining the group! 💎

Fully optimized for all devices, Baton Rouge Hood brings the streets to life like never before. Join now and see if you can make it to the top!
